snippet.title: Blacktower Announce Trailer - Roguelike Card Game
snippet.description:
Blacktower is a roguelike mini-RPG loosely based on Blackjack. Recruit your party, twist fate and push your luck to conquer the Blacktower. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4784720/Blacktower/
